body:
Good find. It looks like a bug, and it exists both in NUnitLite https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/cefc0c3a86c065daa4130aa255b1384db51b2b08/src/NUnitFramework/nunitlite/OutputWriters/NUnit3XmlOutputWriter.cs#L115 and in the regular output https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/a56e6859f3609128128ef87b0226472eb63ea5d4/src/NUnitFramework/framework/Internal/Results/TestResult.cs#L393.

Note that NUnitLite also lacks an attribute with the Warning-count.

@mikkelbu The nunitlite code only replies to the `test-run` element, which it produces. The `test-suite` elements are created by the framework. The engine, of course, also creates `test-run` elements.

I am working on this fix. I will submit PR along with some tests. 
Please assign this to me so that there is no duplication of work.

@CharliePoole I'm not sure I understand what you are saying. Should we leave the NUnitLite as it is, or perhaps just update the `total`, but not add a new `Warning` attribute (I'm guessing the latter, but I'm not sure).

Only that you should fix NUnitLite and the framework itself consistently. The test-run record is not part of what the framework returns. It's added by the execution engine, i.e. nunitlite or nunit.engine.
Our team could use this fix.  @CharliePoole  -- what is the review process to get this into our code?  In the meantime do you have a work around for us?  We relay on that value
Creating a PR __is__ the process. It has had some review and @ashishdawale20 made some further commits. He'll tell us when it's ready to be reviewed again and we'll go on from there.
Sorry, I thought there was already a PR!!! So creating one is the next step.
@CharliePoole  the PR https://github.com/nunit/nunit/pull/3370 is ready to be reviewed.
